newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal to double cement output in two years.
newsitem.headline: Senegal to double cement output in two years.

text.p: Senegal will double annual cement production over the next two years to keep pace with a boom in the building industry, according to the head of the West African country's sole cement factory.
Ousmane Diop, administrator of the privately owned SOCOCIM cement company, told Reuters the increase would come from an extension to its cement plant.
"We will reach production of 1,500,000 tonnes (a year) of cement in 24 months, during which time we will finish the extention of our factory," he said. Current annual production is 813,000 tonnes.
Senegalese living abroad have been investing heavily in property at home since the 1994 devaluation of the CFA franc, which effectively doubled the value of their foreign earnings.
Senegalese Minister of Economy, Papa Ousmane Sacko, has spoken of the need for a second and even a third cement factory in the country.
